original.statement: Native connection details support for composite resources (XRs) is removed; managed resources keep writeConnectionSecretToRef, and XR users must compose their own connection details Secret.

decision.reason: [ev-e2dcb3e0ebe6] says composite resources (XRs) "no longer have native connection details support", so the feature is removed. Its only replacement path is for operators to compose their own connection details Secret. The excerpt names no XR field or setting that could serve as a crd-field subject. That leaves a migration subject built from the text's own key words ("xr-connection-details") with migration-required as the most faithful encoding. Confidence is low because the text says operators "can" recreate the feature rather than "must", so the mandatory framing is inferred from the removal, not stated outright.
